description: Find last-verified apartment listings. Supply a city, state, ZIP, or property name. A neighborhood requires its city. min_rent must not exceed max_rent. Multiple building names may match; use returned IDs. Results include asking rents, verification dates, and source links.

bedrooms.description: Exact bedroom count from 0 to 5. Use 0 for a studio. Omit to include all bedroom counts.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

limit.description: Maximum apartment results to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

max_rent.description: Maximum monthly asking rent in whole US dollars, inclusive. Must be at least min_rent.

min_rent.description: Minimum monthly asking rent in whole US dollars, inclusive. Must not exceed max_rent.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name to match within the supplied city. Supply city with this filter.

offset.description: Number of matching apartment results to skip, from 0 to 10000. Defaults to 0. Use to request later pages.

query.description: Property name or street address text to match. Use 1 to 120 characters. Multiple buildings may match.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example TX. Restrict matches to that state.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code, for example 78704. Keep any leading zero.

name: search_apartments
title: Find apartments
